g.title: Routes telescope and calibration light. Distributes AC, air and glycol to the instrument.
U, V and Z imaging channels. Follow the readout view for detectors, CXP transport and panels.
B, G and R spectrograph channels. One Archon per detector.
YJ, H and K spectrograph channels. DC power and network enter through VIS.
Reduction and quicklook use data on the shared storage.
